Katharine A. Carl, With the Empress Dowager of China.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/katharine-a-carl/with-the-empress-dowager-of-china

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Katharine A. Carl, the author, died 1938 (Wikidata Q1092556, P570 = 1938-01-01 and 1938-12-07; both dates are in 1938).

First publication of the text used: 1905 (SE colophon: 'With the Empress Dowager of China was published in 1905 by Katharine A. Carl.'). The country of first publication is not stated in the facts.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1905, before 1931, so the United States public domain applies to it.
- Country of origin: the only person whose words are in the text, Katharine A. Carl, died in 1938. The facts name no country of first publication, and the English text's possible countries (the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa) each have a term of life + 70 years or less. Since the last death was in 1938, the text is public domain in each of them since 2009.
